system: mixed system of common and customary law

constitution.history: drafted June 1975, ratified 1 October 1978, entered into force 10 May 1979
constitution.amend: proposed by Congress, by a constitutional convention, or by public petition; passage requires approval by at least three-fourths majority vote in at least three fourths of the states
constitution.note: at least every ten years, voters are asked as part of a general or special election whether to hold a constitution convention; a majority of affirmative votes is required to proceed

courts.highest: Federated States of Micronesia Supreme Court (consists of the chief justice and not more than 5 associate justices and organized into appellate and criminal divisions)
courts.judges: justices appointed by the FSM president with the approval of two-thirds of Congress; justices appointed for life
courts.lower: the highest state-level courts are: Chuuk Supreme Court; Korsae State Court; Pohnpei State Court; Yap State Court

citizenship.descent: at least one parent must be a citizen of FSM

world: has not submitted an ICJ jurisdiction declaration; non-party state to the ICCt
